Skin Treatments

Know the names before you book. What each treatment is, who it’s for and how long it lasts.

Just definitions, good to know. Every face and skin is different, so talk to a licensed doctor or qualified provider before deciding. Ask about patch tests, allergies, downtime and your skin tone.
Educational only, not medical advice. Lasting times are typical ranges and vary by person, product, dose and provider.
